name: Bitpanda Transaction History (CSV)
description: Bitpanda transaction history (bitpanda.com: profile > History > Transaction history / 'Export' > CSV; the file 'bitpanda-trades-<date>.csv'). A disclaimer and a 'UserId' line stand above the header Transaction ID, Timestamp, Transaction Type, In/Out, Amount Fiat, Fiat, Amount Asset, Asset, Asset market price, Asset market price currency, Asset class, Product ID, Fee, Fee asset, Spread, Spread Currency, Tax Fiat. Timestamps carry their offset ('2025-01-15T10:00:00+01:00'). Amounts are unsigned; In/Out gives the direction; '-' means empty. A buy/sell row holds both sides: the asset (Amount Asset) and the money (Amount Fiat in Fiat, the other way); cash deposits/withdrawals without an asset amount use Amount Fiat. Fee is booked in Fee asset (often BEST). Incoming 'transfer' rows are rewards (staking, BEST, cashback) and are booked as staking income; transfer(stake)/transfer(unstake) move assets to/from the account 'staking'. Known limits: stocks/ETFs/metals (Asset class) are booked like crypto; the spread is not a separate fee (it is inside the price); swap rows (asset to asset) need checking; type texts not listed fall to unknown.
